question: Can the pinned Cano generator and the now-qualified idealized CPU perception backend reproduce five predeclared topology families and produce topology-consistent diagnostic LiDAR/branch evidence across worlds, before any formal dataset or training?
why_now: The one-world 24-pose CPU contract passed every analytic, determinism, prior-reference, range, clearance, branch and evidence criterion. The next uncertainty is no longer one-mesh raycasting; it is whether topology generation, graph/spline export, deterministic anchor selection and sensor/teacher contracts remain valid across structurally different worlds.

design_correction.old_draft: Five TNG parents, two topology-preserving geometry variants each, 10 mesh worlds and 1,500 observations.
design_correction.problem: The native Cano Poisson mesh is permanently disqualified as a dynamic navigation/collision asset. Therefore footprint/planner rollout cannot honestly certify two native meshes as operational-connectivity-preserving pairs.
design_correction.replacement: This immediate perception pilot uses one native perception mesh per TNG parent: 5 parents, 5 meshes, 50 canonical anchors per parent and 3 deterministic yaw views per anchor, totaling 750 diagnostic observations. The two-geometry paired pilot is deferred until a navigation-grade collision backend exists and is separately approved.
design_correction.effect_on_claims: This pilot may validate cross-topology perception data plumbing and objective branch labels only. It cannot validate dynamic traversability, geometry invariance, Gazebo parity or training sufficiency.

source.reuse_boundary: Use upstream public TNG, spline, point-cloud and mesh APIs through a project-side adapter; do not modify or copy upstream core source.
source.license_boundary: Local research execution only; upstream has no verified LICENSE text at the pinned commit, so redistribution or modified-source publication remains blocked.

topology_registry.recipe: one predeclared grown-tunnel construction, zero connector
topology_registry.required_graph_properties: connected component=1, cycle rank=0, maximum degree<=2, terminal count=2, nonzero cumulative horizontal heading change

topology_registry.recipe: three predeclared grown-tunnel constructions, zero connector
topology_registry.required_graph_properties: connected component=1, cycle rank=0, at least one degree-3 junction and at least three terminals

topology_registry.recipe: three predeclared grown-tunnel constructions plus one connector; project adapter assigns unequal public tunnel-radius parameters
topology_registry.required_graph_properties: connected component=1, cycle rank>=1, at least one degree-3 junction; centerline clearance and branch LOS pass despite radius contrast

topology_registry.recipe: four predeclared grown-tunnel constructions; project adapter requests the upstream spherical-cavity intersection mode through public parameter objects
topology_registry.required_graph_properties: connected component=1, cycle rank=0, at least one degree>=4 junction, at least four outgoing branches and a nonempty chamber surface

topology_registry.recipe: three predeclared grown-tunnel constructions with a frozen nonzero vertical-tendency range, zero connector
topology_registry.required_graph_properties: connected component=1, vertical span>=15 m, finite spline slope, at least one branch and all sensor anchors inside the perception surface

generation_policy: Exactly the five registry entries are attempted once. Upstream bounded per-tunnel n_trials is part of one attempt, but there is no whole-parent retry, alternate seed, replacement family, keep-best selection or scan-quality selection. Each topology is reconstructed once without meshing for graph/spline hash replay, so the run records 5 primary topology constructions plus 5 replay constructions and exactly 5 mesh generations.
seed_separation_method: Reset NumPy/Python/upstream counters with topology_seed, construct and freeze canonical graph/splines, then reseed NumPy/Python with geometry_seed immediately before TunnelNetworkPtClGenParams and mesh generation. Record RNG states, source hashes and canonical hashes. A unit control must prove changing geometry_seed leaves graph/spline hashes unchanged and changing topology_seed changes at least one canonical topology identity.

sampling.view_rule: Same sensor origin at the deterministic centerline anchor; yaw is local tangent plus -30, 0 and +30 degrees. This is a predeclared circular-equivariance diagnostic, not three independent places.
sampling.anchor_rule: Include every structural event with deterministic center/incident-spline offsets, then fill to exactly 50 by farthest-point selection on 0.5 m splines with at least 5 m spacing. No LiDAR result is used for selection; inability to obtain exactly 50 stops that parent.
sampling.sensor: Frozen Open3D 0.19.0 CPU first return, 16x720, elevations -15..15 degrees step 2, azimuth 0.5 degree, 0.3--50 m, no noise, range_m plus valid_mask.
sampling.teacher: Frozen 5 m sphere/spline outgoing-heading oracle, 8 degree deduplication and 720-bin sigma-3-degree circular Gaussian; graph/splines are teacher/provenance only and never student input.

implementation_before_execution: Add a project-side topology/geometry seed-separated adapter without modifying upstream source.
Add deterministic five-family graph-property validators and 50-anchor selector.
Add a governance operation/card schema for a multi-world non-formal sensor contract pilot; the current one-world sensor_smoke schema must not be weakened.
Store observations as 5 world-level compressed diagnostic shards plus JSONL/JSON manifests, not 750 loose NPZ files; Zarr remains reserved for a later formal data card.
Add complete-page visualization and provenance generation, runner sealing and unit/external contract tests.
Freeze all code, source, environment, recipes, seeds, counts, thresholds and command hashes; run full tests and non-mutating preflight before execution.
acceptance_criteria: The prerequisite one-world PASS, approval, upstream source/cleanliness, E1 environment and every frozen code/config identity match.
Exactly five predeclared topology parents and no alternate seed/retry are attempted; every upstream tunnel call reports explicit success and every family satisfies its listed graph properties.
Primary and replay construction produce identical canonical graph and spline hashes for all five parents; topology/geometry seed separation controls pass.
Exactly five readable native perception meshes are produced and retain their known non-navigation risk; no repair, component selection or collision/navigation qualification is claimed.
Exactly 250 deterministic anchors and 750 views are selected without scan-quality selection; parent/place/view identities and dependency counts are explicit.
Every 16x720 range/valid output passes the frozen near/far/dtype contract; two fresh scenes have identical masks and maximum valid-range difference <=1e-6 m.
Every anchor has horizontal clearance >=0.8 m, every 5 m oracle branch ray is clear to target minus 0.25 m and local branch count/headings are consistent with visible spline events.
All 750 observations are represented without best-case selection in fixed 25-scan pages: exactly 30 contact-sheet pages, plus five complete world/TNG/anchor maps and machine-readable provenance.

M-TARE benchmark paths are absent from manifests; graph/splines/absolute world pose/parent ID are absent from student-array fields; formal-data/training/model/AI/Isaac/Gazebo/topology-runtime/M-TARE counts remain zero.
RUN_STATE, raw metrics, failure records, summary and SHA-256 evidence manifest are complete; result size <=2 GB and wall time <=2 hours.

decision_rule.pass: Authorize only design and separate approval of a CPU-to-Gazebo fixed-pose parity gate and a navigation-grade geometry route. Do not yet create formal data or train.
decision_rule.generator_family_fail: Report the exact unsupported family/recipe and choose between a controlled Cano TNG template adapter or reducing the claimed generator coverage; do not seed-hunt.
decision_rule.perception_fail: Stop on the first affected parent and preserve the failure; compare geometry construction only in a separately approved A/B, without lowering sensor or label thresholds.
decision_rule.governance_or_environment_fail: Repair only implementation/governance or restore frozen identity after reporting; do not execute or automatically retry.

stop_rule: No implementation or execution before explicit approval of this corrected 5-parent/5-mesh/750-observation scope. After approval: one run only, no retry, alternate seed, replacement parent, second geometry, mesh repair, threshold change, noise/randomization, AI labeling, Isaac/Gazebo, formal export, training, topology runtime or M-TARE work.
planned_outputs: five auditable topology/mesh bundles plus five deterministic replay hash records
five world-level diagnostic observation shards containing all 750 observations
per-parent/per-anchor sensor, label, determinism, clearance and branch metrics
five full world/TNG/anchor maps and thirty fixed-scale 25-scan contact-sheet pages with provenance
source/environment/tool/config snapshots, raw logs, summary, RUN_STATE and evidence manifest

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only in frozen E1: 5 primary plus 5 graph-only replay topology constructions, 5 native Poisson meshes and 17.28 million primary rays across two fresh Open3D scenes; no GPU, Docker, Isaac, Gazebo, AI API or training.
